title: Ariadne Playbook
description: Schema for versioned Ariadne penetration-test playbooks

id.description: Stable, globally unique playbook identifier (e.g. network.tcp-discovery.v1)

version.description: Monotonic version number for this playbook

stage.description: Engagement phase this playbook belongs to (e.g. discovery, enumeration)

triggers.description: Conditions that make this playbook eligible

required_evidence_types.description: Evidence types that must exist before this playbook is eligible

capabilities.description: Capabilities this playbook requires (e.g. scan.tcp, service.enum)

actions.description: Ordered adapter operations this playbook executes

limits.description: Resource limits declared by this playbook

stop_conditions.description: Conditions that should halt plan execution

success_emits.description: Observation types this playbook emits on success

next_playbooks.description: Playbook ids that are natural successors after this one

report_sections.description: Report sections this playbook contributes to
